text: Election of the Vice Chair of the Audit Committee under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix AII, for a term of office starting on February 22, 2019 and ending December 31, 2020, and until a successor is appointed.

The Audit Committee: 1. Elected Councillor John Filion as Vice Chair of the Audit Committee for a term of office starting February 22, 2019 and ending December 31, 2020, and until a successor is appointed. ______________ There was one nomination. The Clerk declared Councillor John Filion the Vice Chair of the Audit Committee.
